    # Four 4x4 masks, separated by the color-3 dividers.
    # At each cell retain the topmost color in the observed overlay order:
    # 9 > 4 > 8 > 5.
    priority = (5, 8, 4, 9)
    out = []
    for r in range(4):
        row = []
        for c in range(4):
            present = [grid[r][start + c] for start in (0, 5, 10, 15)
                       if grid[r][start + c] != 0]
            row.append(max(present, key=priority.index) if present else 0)
        out.append(row)
    return out
